changes.change: **The stairway.** Every plan climbs in weekly steps: small steps in the first half (standard 3 %), slightly bigger after the halfway week (standard 5 %), the hardest weeks last. When a muscle's level cap would be reached early, all its steps are scaled down by one factor λ so the planned peak lands on the cap in the final week. Replaces the 12-week acclimation cap (≤ 3 %), the 8-week "start hard" (start × 1.10, weeks 1-4 ≤ 5 %) and target-seeking.
changes.changed_again_in_v1_2: stairway approved; it climbs from the week-1 sets; time-limited ceilings (COACH-R3 VOL-04, SES-02)

changes.change: **"Start at a 2, end at an 11"** is perceived overall load, not sets: each week shows a level from 2 to 11 that follows the stairway, and the planned effort drifts from 3 RIR to 1 RIR inside his 1-3 RIR band; lifters already at their caps get the "11" from load, intensifiers and a rotating priority muscle.

**Never above 7 %/week planned; 10 % absolute.** Standard steps are 3-5 %; a "too easy" week adds 2 points (max 7 %); the person's total weekly resistance sets must rise by less than 10 %. A hand-set step runs 0-7 % (fixes 03's conflict 4).
changes.changed_again_in_v1_2: the 'too easy' +2 points is retired with the check-in; one-set allowance under the 10 % ceiling (COACH-R3 VOL-02; PROPOSED)

changes.change: **Check-in step table approved, minus the life column.** Effort mostly 1-6 → the planned step + 2 points (= his +7 % in the late half); effort 7-8 → the planned step (= his +5 % in the late half); effort 9 → hold; any 10 → hold and remove 1 set from that day; under half the sessions → repeat the week. The step is decided from **effort, completion and pain only**: the "life was harder / better" cells are dropped because he wants no lifestyle inputs (**flagged**).

**Retired:** the readiness score R (effort 40 / completion 20 / performance 20 / life 20), the intake "recovery signal" (sleep, stress, physical job), the 3 % default for stressed clients, "7 % only once logs earn it" and the "hold 2 weeks → deload" gate.
**No check-in = no adaptation:** the plan follows its planned stairway ("there is no data to go off of").
changes.changed_again_in_v1_2: there is no check-in at all: the planned stairway is the only path (COACH-R3 VOL-02, VOL-04)

changes.change: **Effort 10 = "the max I could do, but successful"** (0 RIR), not a fail; an optional separate 'Failed' answer is proposed. '8 - That was perfect' = hit the target the plan gave; '9' = harder than planned.
changes.changed_again_in_v1_2: effort is never read back; 'Failed' retired (COACH-R3 VOL-02)

changes.change: **Floor 10 sets a week per trained muscle; small muscles grow by the same idea.** Small-muscle starts L1 **10** (was 8) / L2 12 / L3 15; the level caps 14 / 22 / 25 now apply to every target muscle (small caps were 12 / 18 / 22); priority caps L1 18 / L2 26-28 / L3 30 approved; every cap is customizable; an optional **Pro** setting may let one priority muscle pass 30 (numbers PROPOSED).
changes.changed_again_in_v1_2: floor of 10 read on groups (COACH-R3 VOL-01, SES-01)

changes.change: **"Most people train 20-30 sets per muscle per week"**: researched (surveys of bodybuilders and gym-goers, dose-response meta-analyses, RP landmarks) and placed next to his statement.

**Rear delts:** own sets 4 / 6 / 8 approved. Reconciled with the floor of 10 by reading the floor on his SHOULDERS/TRAPS muscle group (rear + side delt work together) - INFERRED and **flagged** for round 3.
changes.changed_again_in_v1_2: rear delts' own 4/6/8 retired as a number: part of the shoulders group (COACH-R3 VOL-01)

changes.change: **Glute credit:** squats, lunges, deadlifts and RDLs give glutes **0.25** (hinges were 0.5 PROPOSED); hip thrusts and bridges 1.0; **KB swings are ballistic and never count as glute volume**; thruster = 1.0 quads + 0.5 shoulders + 0.25 glutes.

**No deload or maintenance week inside a block.** A block is completed; the deload (about half of the hardest week, same exercises, 3+ RIR) sits only between blocks. A block that cannot be completed is cancelled → maintenance phase (length chosen, extendable) → at its end the app asks: keep maintaining / change the plan / start a training block. Triggered mid-block deloads are retired.
changes.changed_again_in_v1_2: block-at-risk prompt and maintenance end prompt retired; the easy week is a recommendation (COACH-R3 VOL-02, PER-01)

changes.change: **R2-VOL-08 was not understood:** the default stays (alternate the first exercise between the two weekly exposures; bonus exercise on the optional day; with no optional day, on a day that already trains that muscle group) and is marked for a simpler re-ask.

**Full-body days: 2-4 exercises per muscle group that day, never 1.** Full-body days grow to 7-10 resistance exercises and 55-80 minutes; the time model adds a 1-minute changeover per exercise; the capacity table and every example were recomputed.
changes.changed_again_in_v1_2: groups approved; calves one exercise x 3 sets per leg day; time-vs-minimums policy (COACH-R3 SES-01, SES-02)

changes.change: **Session rules:** heavy squat and heavy deadlift on two different days, non-axial alternatives on the other days, the counted list of axial lifts; light core opener (2 exercises × 2 sets short of failure) with optional core supersets or monster sets anywhere; field athletes 12 exercises + the 2-exercise core block; athletic-template slots default to 2 sets (03's conflict 1); exercises by session length 45 ≈ 5, 60 ≈ 6-7, 75-90 ≈ 8-9 (03's conflict 6).

**Athletic budget:** plyo:ballistic shares by sport approved (end of block; each block starts 15 points more ballistic; share counted over jump **and** throw work); ballistic vs plyometric lists; "Receive-Create stages" (1 Land, 2 Land & Go, 3 Repeat) with their week timing; Olympic lifts up to 4 times a week (cleans on squat-pattern days, snatches on hinge days); full squat cleans/snatches 3-5 reps with the same weekly reps; % only when tested (RPE otherwise); in-season reductions for game-heavy sports; older adults (60+) no Olympic lifts, plyos or depth jumps by default (optional with a warning); youth Olympic lifts from the floor from about 14 after a hang block; intermediates get the full Olympic scope (11's I14).

changes.change: **Pre-season** = a 4-6-week block at about 60 % of off-season sets with more speed and power, then a 1-2-week taper; **maintenance** length is chosen and extendable.
**Year plan** = gen-pop "stay in shape" planning, fully tunable by the user (re-order blocks, more or less cardio, a winter powerlifting-style block; own calendar and holiday weeks).

changes.change: **Tests** before the block (or in week 1) and at the end, never mid-block; untrained people never test a 1RM or a max mile from zero (5RM / 3RM or 80-90 % submax efforts).
**Next block** after a completed block: start × 1.05, cap + 1 (max 25 non-priority / 30 priority) approved; after a cancelled block: the same start (PROPOSED).

changes.change: **Inconsistencies flagged by 03 and 11 fixed here:** priority add +4 (L1-L2) / +6 (L3) everywhere (I10); factor results round half up (I11); intermediates get the full Olympic scope (I14); the bodybuilder upper-body share is PROPOSED, not his number (I15); 8-9 exercises at 75-90 min is his VOL-08 answer (I16); hand-set step 0-7 % and RIR stays 1-3 (03 conflicts 2 and 4).

# ---------- 0. intake -> profile (few inputs; no sleep / stress / job questions; nothing stored: COACH-R2 GEN-04, COACH-R3 GEN-01) ----------
level = level_from_experience(years_consistent, months_off, ex_pro)        # PRG-05 (L1/L2/L3)
goal, sport, position, season_start, practice_game_days = intake...        # GEN-02, R2-GEN-05
age, body_weight, pain_areas = intake...                                    # GEN-02 (age and pain are training inputs)
days, minutes = intake...                                                   # chosen week; checked by the time policy (3.10.1)
focus = intake.focus_muscles               # 0-2 lines, each +F (default 2, 1-3): COACH-R3 SES-01
play_days, event_date = intake...          # stay-active users (COACH-R3 ATH-05), optional
blocks_completed = intake.blocks_completed # 0 by default; drives start x 1.05 and ceiling + 1 (R2-VOL-06; input PROPOSED)
mode = intake.plan_mode                    # '12wk' | '8wk' | 'block_4_6' | 'maintenance' | 'pre_season' | 'yearly'  (week-by-week retired)

# ---------- 1. weekly targets per LINE (FOCUS headers; shoulders = all delts) ----------
LINES = [quads, hamstrings, glutes, chest, back, shoulders, biceps, triceps, calves]          # COACH-R3 VOL-01
GROUPS = {quads:[quads], hips:[hamstrings, glutes], chest, back, shoulders, biceps, triceps, calves}   # COACH-R3 SES-01
for m in LINES:
    start[m] = START_TABLE[m][level]                                                         # 3.3 (VOL-01, R2-VOL-04)
    start[m] = round_half_up(start[m] * GOAL_PHASE_FACTOR[goal, season][region(m)])          # 3.4
    for k in range(blocks_completed): start[m] = round_half_up(start[m] * 1.05)              # R2-VOL-06
    cap[m] = CAP_TABLE[level] + blocks_completed (max 25 / 30)
    if m in focus: start[m] += F[m]; cap[m] = min(cap[m] + F[m], PRIORITY_CAP[level])          # COACH-R3 SES-01
    if m in pain_lines: start[m] *= 0.5 to 0.7; cap[m] = start[m] + 1                        # VOL-03 (pain wins over the floor)
    if mode == 'maintenance': start[m] = factor * last_block_final4_avg[m]; cap[m] = start[m]  # flat, not floored
    if mode == 'pre_season':  start[m] = 0.6 * off_season_sets[m]; cap[m] = start[m]          # flat, not floored
floor_groups(start, 10)            # every directly trained GROUP >= 10 with group credit (R2-VOL-06, COACH-R3 VOL-01)
share_target = SHARE_TABLE[profile][phase]; apply pain shift                                 # 3.11

# ---------- 2. week-1 build ----------
slots = template(goal, days, minutes)       # 05: 2-4 exercises per group per trained day, calves 1 x 3 per leg day,
                                            # core opener 2x2, hip+push / knee+pull, heavy squat and deadlift on different days
fit: trim lines > start+1 (latest isolation first, min 2 sets); add to lines < start-1 with place_set()
S[m] = max(start[m], week1_sets[m])         # the stairway climbs from the week-1 build (3.3, 3.7.1)

# ---------- 3. the planned stairway (3.7.1; approved COACH-R3 VOL-04) ----------
N = block_length(mode); h = ceil(N / 2)
std = {w: 0.03 if w <= h else 0.05 for w in 2..N}
for m in LINES:
    lam[m] = 1 if S[m] * prod(1 + s for s in std) <= cap[m] else solve(S[m] * prod(1 + lam*s) == cap[m])
    if coach_priority_push and m not in push: plan_step[m][w] = min(lam[m] * std[w], 0.03)   # optional (R2-VOL-06)
level_display[w] = 2 + 9 * A(w) / A(N); rir[w] = rir_for_level(level_display[w])           # 3 -> 2 -> 1-2 -> 1 RIR + intensifiers

# ---------- 4. time vs minimums (3.10.1; COACH-R3 SES-02) ----------
plan = run_block(slots, targets)            # inside the chosen minutes, supersets where a day needs them
if not meets_minimums(plan) or peaks_lower(plan):
    show_up_front(offer_extra_day(), offer_minutes(ceil5(peak_week_need)), offer_block_toggles())
    if user_takes_offer: rebuild with it
    elif not meets_minimums(plan):
        kept = pinned + focus_groups; for g in [hips, quads, back, chest, shoulders, calves, triceps, biceps]:
            if meets_minimums(plan_for(kept + [g], start_at_floor=True)): kept.append(g)
        list_not_trained_directly(GROUPS - kept, with their compound credit)
mark_superset_recommendations(every eligible pair)                      # step 3
plan = two_pass_stairway(plan)            # step 4: each kept line lands on the ceiling its time holds, never flat

# ---------- 5. the weekly loop: computed once, all weeks shown (no deload inside the block; no check-in) ----------
T = dict(S)
for w in 2..N:
    for m in LINES (Focus and pinned first, then big, then small):
        T[m] = min(cap[m], T[m] * (1 + plan_step[m][w]))
        while T[m] - weekly_sets[m] >= 1 and weekly_sets[m] + 1 <= cap[m]:
            if total_after_add >= 1.10 * total_last_week and some set was already added this week: break   # UNI-05
            if not place_set(m): break                                          # time, exercise or session limits
    if exercise_block_boundary(w): change_one_small_variable(); rebalance_share(share_target)   # PER-02, R2-LIB-01
    emit(week)                              # with blocks, toggles, superset recommendations, effort cue, self-adjust guide

# ---------- 6. after the block ----------
print('recommended: an easy week at about half of the hardest week, then build your next block')    # COACH-R3 PER-01
tests: before the block (or week 1) and at the end; untrained -> 5RM/3RM or 80-90 % efforts, never 1RM or max mile   # R2-PER-07

def place_set(m):                                                       # COACH-R3 VOL-03
    for day in alternate(days_training(m)):                            # Monday's first exercise, then Thursday's
        group = laterality_group(m, share_target)
        ex = first exercise in session order with sets < sets of the first, else the first (below max)   # VOL-07
        if fits(ex, per_exercise_max, per_session_line_cap=11 (14 Focus), session_minutes): ex.sets += 1; return True
        if superset_frees_time(day): enable_superset(day); retry
    if m == calves: return add_to_optional_day_calves_slot()           # never a 2nd calf exercise on a leg day (R3-SES-01)
    if m is small: return add_bonus(m, prefer=optional_day, else=a day that already trains m, never its only exercise there)
    if m is big:   return add_focus_slot(m, prefer=optional_day, else=a day that already trains the region)
    return False

def edit(plan, edits):                     # COACH-R3 SES-02: toggles, add / remove exercise or block -> rebuild, nothing stored
    return build(intake, constraints=edits)
